name: Haiku concentrated AI/technology
strategy: Concentrated AI semiconductor and infrastructure play - chips and fab tools critical for enterprise AI training/inference deployment, with differentiation from Round 2's platform/cloud focus.
reassessment_note: Previous Round 3 book (TNA, IWD, XLE small-cap cyclicals) drifted from mandate into non-AI cyclical momentum, creating misalignment with 'concentrated AI/technology' mandate. Market this week validates semiconductor infrastructure thesis: CRM/SNOW beat on AI metrics confirming accelerating enterprise AI deployment; NVDA guidance shows supply-constrained through FY28; $1 trillion in AI chips expected 2026-2027. Semiconductor scarcity is the binding constraint for AI buildout. Shifting Round 3 to chips/fab tools (NVDA, AMD, ASML, QCOM) + cloud infrastructure (MSFT) creates differentiation from Round 2's enterprise platforms (CRM, ADBE) while staying concentrated in AI/tech mandate. Sep 16 Fed rate hike risk is material for growth stocks, but AI compute demand is structural with 2027+ visibility, and semiconductors have more tangible asset backing than pure software.

positions.thesis: Indispensable for AI training/inference; no viable alternatives at scale. Guidance of $108B Q3 with supply-constrained visibility through FY28 confirms structural multi-year demand. Dominance in GPU compute for LLM workloads. Primary bottleneck solver for AI infrastructure.

Gaining share in data center AI chips with EPYC Milan-X and next-gen processors. Lower valuation than NVDA with higher upside potential. Competition drives innovation and adoption. Beneficiary of $1 trillion AI chip demand forecasted for 2026-2027.

Monopoly supplier of EUV lithography equipment; critical bottleneck for chip manufacturing at advanced nodes required for AI chips. Government support for semiconductor capacity and geopolitical diversification. Supplies all major foundries (TSMC, Samsung) producing AI chips.

Mobile/edge AI opportunity through Snapdragon platform. AI inference moving to devices reduces cloud load. Beneficiary of distributed AI inference trend and device-level AI adoption. Participation in chip infrastructure with lower beta.

Azure infrastructure layer for enterprise AI deployment. Position differentiated from Round 2 focus; here emphasizing cloud hardware/infrastructure access rather than cloud platform business. Hyperscaler capex expansion driving datacenter investment.

AI data/analytics platform with direct enterprise AI deployment exposure. Focused on data integration and AI applications at scale. Differentiated from Round 2's business application software (CRM, ADBE). Speculative higher-upside AI infrastructure play.

3x leveraged semiconductor ETF provides tactical diversified exposure to AI chip sector. Amplifies infrastructure theme with leverage. Appropriate for concentrated portfolio given 5% dry powder. Hedges single-company risk concentration while maintaining AI infrastructure focus.
